item.name: Beach Cleanup
item.description:
[WATCH - Fiesta Island Beach Cleanup Video - HERE](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wi11ux6bPOQ)

##Time
2 Hours of Beach Cleanup and then stay for the sunset!

##About
Join us at some of our beautiful local beaches in San Diego, CA, as we work together to clean up our community! Every month, we focus on a different area, and your participation can make a significant impact on the health of our waterways and oceans.

Here are some important details:

- Volunteers of all ages are welcome! Please bring your own reusable cleaning supplies such as buckets, gloves, and grabbers since we are unable to provide them at this time.

- On the day of the cleanup, one of our Naturalists will meet you to kickstart your volunteer service.

- As a token of our gratitude, San Diego Whale Watch will provide the FIRST 30 volunteers with a FREE pass to join us for a thrilling whale watching adventure! We kindly request two things in return: first, please spread awareness about your efforts by posting a group photo on Facebook or Instagram, and second, track the trash collected using the CleanSwell app. The app's link will be provided in the confirmation email.

- Feel free to get creative with your photos! Capture moments of you picking up litter, trash in the environment, or proudly displaying full buckets of collected trash.


Don't forget to tag @sdwhalewatch and include the following three hashtags in your posts: #sdwhalewatch, #beachcleanup, #plasticpollution.

Thank you for joining us and helping to keep our rivers, beaches, and oceans clean!

##Rates
All Ages: Free!
item.booking_notes:
##You will see our table set-up with a San Diego Whale Watch banner and blue tent. Please call 619-542-9931 if you have trouble finding us.

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/qFa6fQEqSouPeVtynx1s)

**Thank you for volunteering your time to participate in San Diego Whale Watch's Beach Cleanup!** Your efforts make a big difference for the health of our beaches and oceans. During this Beach Cleanup you, your family, and friends can enjoy a nice outdoor activity while making a huge difference! Walk this high-traffic park to beautify our local beachy community! 

## **On the Day of the Cleanup:**
Bring a bucket from home, grab some kitchen or gardening gloves. You can make this cleanup zero-waste by using your own reusable supplies!

We will jump-start the Beach Cleanup with a quick safety chat upon check-in, then you can spend a couple hours cleaning up!

**DISCLAIMER:** By participating in this cleanup, you agree San Diego Whale Watch is NOT responsible for any injury suffered and you waive any claim arising from participation in the event. You agree to read and follow all of the safety protocols for this event.

 **What to Bring:**
- Reusable Cleaning Supplies: Buckets or a bag from home and Gardening Gloves

**Citizen Science:**
We are participating in tracking our efforts by using the mobile app [CleanSwell](https://oceanconservancy.org/trash-free-seas/international-coastal-cleanup/clean-swell-app/) to easily record each item of trash you collect. This is a global effort by other wonderful people like you, to create a snapshot of ocean trash. This data will be sent to I Love A Clean San Diego & the Ocean Conservancy. Please download the app and familiarize yourself with it, before the beach cleanup. 

You will record
- Every item of trash you collect
- The total weight of the trash you collect

---

## Thank you!
###San Diego Whale Watch will be giving registered participants a FREE pass to join us for a whale watching adventure! 

## **Free Pass Requirements:**
**1.** Submit your completed Data Card of total pounds of trash collected. You can track as you clean and submit to the check-in table after the cleanup. We will calculate how much trash we picked up as a team! 
We ask that you please spread awareness of your efforts by:
**2.** Posting **one** photo per group to Facebook or Instagram
**3.** In your posts, please tag **@sdwhalewatch** and include the following 3 hashtags: **#sdwhalewatch #beachcleanup #plasticpollution** 
**Photo ideas** include a picture of you picking up litter, trash in the environment, and displaying full buckets of trash...Be creative!


###We can't wait to meet you and again thank you so much for helping us keep our beaches and oceans clean!
item.cancellation_notes:
**Cancellation Policy:**
We have a limited open availability for Beach Cleanups, so please call or email us letting us know if you are unable to make it. We typically have a waiting list, so please let us know at least **48 hours** in advance, if you are unable to make it. Thank you!
